about: Targin covers 12 January to 26 July. The seven-day Movicol prescription in February has ended by the six-month point on 12 July.
Morphine supplies cover 4 November 2025 to 13 July 2026 without prescribed laxative cover. Moviprep at L022 is a single bowel preparation for a procedure.
A hospital prescription for 28 days of prucalopride from 10 July covers the six-month opioid threshold on 12 July and the rest of the opioid course.
